preconditions.description: t is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 100 and 1 <= y <= 100 for x, y in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]])
preconditions.description: Each test case contains two integers x and y, each between 1 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all((x == y and (a == 0 or b == 1)) or (y % x == 0 and (a := int(math.log(y / x, b))) > 0 and b > 0 and b == int(y / (x ** (1 / a))) and x * (b ** a) == y) for x, y, line in zip([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]], [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]], stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]) if (a := 1) and (b := 1) or (y % x == 0 and (a := int(math.log(y / x, b))) > 0 and b > 0 and b == int(y / (x ** (1 / a))) and x * (b ** a) == y) else (a := 0) and (b := 0))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if there exist positive integers a and b such that x * (b ** a) == y, output a and b (1 ≤ a, b ≤ 10^9). Otherwise, output 0 0.

postconditions.expression: all((a == 0 and b == 0) or (a > 0 and b > 0 and x * (b ** a) == y) for x, y, a, b in zip([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]], [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]], [int(out.split()[0]) for out in stdout.splitlines()], [int(out.split()[1]) for out in stdout.splitlines()]))
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is either a valid pair (a, b) satisfying x * (b ** a) == y, or (0, 0) if no such pair exists.
